notes.title: Big demo update!

tags.feature: [*] Ability to save from the game menu at any time;
[*] Flexible sound and text settings: adjust the speed of dialogs, music volume and voiceovers;
[*] Improved character movement animation: simulated walking instead of just moving sprites;
[*] Updated interface of dialogs and in-game smartphone, which became more intuitive and functional;
[*] Added support for Chinese and Japanese languages;

tags.bug: [*] Fixed minor bugs for more comfortable passing.

notes.title: BUG Fix + add Achievements
notes.content:
Three new achievements have been added to the demo version of The Hungry Town! Which ones? Find out for yourself! 😎
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44305075/1fdf4eca24c629882ca21fdf9e8d6e316cce8265.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44305075/5f052ee4319a3a1bde42e07dd219ea6e3b181a37.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44305075/1fdf4eca24c629882ca21fdf9e8d6e316cce8265.png[/img]
[b]Important fixes have also been made:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed graphical issues.
[*] ❗️The biggest bug has been defeated! The game now properly adapts to all types of monitors.
[i]I spent a lot of time working on this problem and finally solved it. I even bought an old square monitor for testing 😅. Now, if a monitor is too wide or too tall, the game automatically adds black frames for optimal display 👀.[/i]
[/list]
